sources.title: Onboarding SOP — assumed outline (the customer's SOP was not supplied)
sources.summary: PLACEHOLDER. No procedure text, roles, service levels or approval rules were supplied with the request and the working directory was empty. The sections below are a conventional onboarding sequence assumed by provia-workflow-designer so the design could proceed; every section is a recommendation to confirm or replace with the customer's SOP (decision D1). Country Angola and language en are provisional (decision D8).

sections.title: HR opens the onboarding case once the hire is approved
sections.summary: Assumed: a person in Human Resources starts the case with the new employee's name, job title, department, start date and hiring manager, once the hiring approval exists.

sections.title: Start details confirmed with the hiring manager
sections.summary: Assumed: HR confirms the start date, job title and department with the hiring manager before preparing anything.

sections.title: Contract drafted and admission documents collected
sections.summary: Assumed: HR prepares the draft contract and collects identification, tax, social-security and bank documents from the new hire.

sections.title: Contract approved before signature
sections.summary: Assumed: HR Management approves the draft contract, returns it for correction, or cancels the onboarding.

sections.title: Contract signed
sections.summary: Assumed: HR arranges the signing; the new hire may sign, postpone or withdraw.

sections.title: Accounts and equipment provisioned
sections.summary: Assumed: IT Support creates accounts and prepares equipment before the start date.

sections.title: Payroll and statutory registrations
sections.summary: Assumed: HR registers the employee in payroll and submits the social-security and tax registrations the organization is obliged to make. No statutory deadline is asserted.

sections.title: First-day welcome and induction
sections.summary: Assumed: the hiring manager receives the employee, hands over equipment and completes a signed induction checklist.

sections.title: End-of-probation review
sections.summary: Assumed: the hiring manager evaluates the employee at the end of the probation period and confirms, extends or ends the employment; HR closes the file. Probation length unknown.

groups.name: Human Resources
groups.purpose: Opens onboarding cases, prepares the contract, collects documents, registers payroll and closes the file. Real name of the unit unknown.

flags.detail: The SOP was not supplied; the unit's actual name and members are unknown (decision D2).
Prepares the contract (prepare_contract) while hr_management approves it (approve_contract); keep the two groups separate (decision D5).

groups.name: HR Management
groups.purpose: Approves the employment contract before signature and owns the workflow design. Assumed approver; the SOP may name a different authority.

flags.detail: Assumed approver; the actual approving authority is decision D5.
Likely one person; a group is proposed so approvals survive absences. Delegate to be named (decision D5).
Approves what hr prepares; must not be the same people.

groups.name: Hiring managers
groups.purpose: Fallback owner for the actions the design assigns to the person in the `hiring_manager` case field (induction and probation review); the product cannot assign from a field yet, so the owner is set per case.

flags.detail: Membership unknown; whether hiring managers exist as a group in the organization is decision D2.

groups.name: IT Support
groups.purpose: Creates accounts and prepares equipment before the start date.

flags.detail: Assumed actor; the SOP may split accounts (IT) from equipment and badges (general services) — decision D2.

workflows.name: Employee onboarding

grants.reason: Human Resources opens every onboarding case once the hire is approved (assumed).
Owns the process and the workflow design; may publish new versions (assumed process owner).

access.note: Onboarding cases carry personal documents (identification, tax, social-security and bank data) and contract terms. `internal` is provisional: the source's own words are unavailable. If the organization treats these files as restricted (decision D6), change sensitivity to `restricted`; the create_incident grant to hr then means every HR starter sees every onboarding case. IT Support and hiring managers get no grant: they see the cases that carry their actions.

unresolvedEntityTypes.name: Employee
unresolvedEntityTypes.detail: The case concerns a person who will become an employee record. No entity registry was supplied and the tenant could not be read; whether an Employee entity type exists and should be linked is decision D7 (provia-information-model).

actions.name: Register the hire and confirm the start details
evidence: Hiring approval attached to the case
Comment confirming start date, job title and department with the hiring manager

folded.summary: Confirming the start details with the hiring manager is step 2 of the HR starter's task, not a separate manager action.

actions.name: Prepare the employment contract and collect the new hire's documents

folded.summary: Requesting the documents from the new hire (an external party) is a step of the HR task; the new hire has no Provia group.

actions.name: Decide on the employment contract
evidence: Mandatory comment on «Return for correction» and «Cancel the onboarding»

actions.name: Record the outcome of the contract signing

folded.summary: Arranging the signing appointment with the new hire is step 1 of the HR task.

actions.name: Provision the accounts and equipment
evidence: Comment listing the accesses created and the equipment serial numbers

folded.summary: Informing the hiring manager and HR of missing equipment is the exception path of the IT task, not a notification action (recommendation for provia-automation-designer).

actions.name: Register the employee in payroll and social security
evidence: Comment with each registration and its date

dueInSource.text: Statutory registration deadlines are not asserted: the SOP and the jurisdiction confirmation are unavailable (decision D8).

actions.name: Conduct the first-day welcome and induction

dueInSource.text: On the employee's first day (`start_date`); a due offset from activation cannot express a case-field date.

folded.summary: Handing over equipment and testing accesses is step 1 of the manager's induction, not a separate IT action.

actions.name: Prepare the probation review
evidence: Comment with the date the evaluation template was sent to the hiring manager

dueInSource.text: Before `probation_end_date`; the probation length is unknown (decision D4) and a due offset cannot express a case-field date.

folded.summary: Sending the evaluation template to the manager is a step of the HR preparation, not a notification action (recommendation for provia-automation-designer).

actions.name: Decide on the end of the probation period
evidence: Mandatory comment on «Extend» and «End during probation»

actions.name: Close the onboarding record
evidence: Comment with the final status and the filing date

folded.summary: Opening the separation process after «End during probation» is out of scope; the closing action records the hand-off (decision D9).

setupNotes: Design built on an assumed outline: the customer's onboarding SOP was not supplied and the tenant could not be read (org_get_context not permitted). Replace source sop-onboarding-assumed with the real SOP and re-run the design before packaging (D1).

induct_employee and review_probation are owned by the person in the `hiring_manager` case field; the product cannot assign from a field, so the owner is set manually per case (fallback group: Hiring managers).
No due offsets are set: no service level was supplied (D3). Deadlines tied to start_date and probation_end_date are recorded in dueInSource and need manual configuration or a case calendar.
workflow.yaml carries access grants by group name (Human Resources, HR Management); regenerate with scripts/emit-workflow-access.mjs once the manifest group names are confirmed.

No document templates are cited because the source is unavailable; the admission checklist, contract template, induction checklist and evaluation template named in the descriptions must be identified and listed in templates[] once the SOP is supplied.

decisions.question: Supply the actual onboarding SOP (or confirm each assumed section A1–A9). The whole design rests on an assumed outline; any section the SOP contradicts changes the actions and branches.

Confirm the real names and members of the actors: the HR unit (hr), the approving HR authority (hr_management), IT Support (it_support), and whether hiring managers exist as a group or are set per case only.
Which service levels apply to each action (days before start date for the contract, accounts and registrations; days for the approval; days for closing)? No due was set because none was supplied.
What is the probation period, may it be extended, and who decides at its end (assumed: the hiring manager, with HR preparing the review)?

Who approves the employment contract before signature (assumed: HR Management), what is their authority limit, and who is the delegate in their absence? The design keeps preparation (hr) and approval (hr_management) in separate groups.
decisions.owner: Head of Human Resources — to be named

decisions.question: Are onboarding files (identification, bank and social-security data, contract terms) treated as restricted in the organization? If yes, sensitivity becomes `restricted` and every HR starter sees every onboarding case (access.note).
Does an Employee entity type exist in Provia, and should the onboarding case create or link the employee record? Recorded in unresolvedEntityTypes as `employee`.
Confirm the country and jurisdiction (Angola is a provisional context) and which statutory registrations and deadlines apply to a new employee. None are asserted in the design.
Which process handles the separation when the decision is «End during probation» or the hire withdraws after signature? The closing action records the hand-off only.

Should the new hire, the hiring manager and IT be notified automatically (case opened, contract signed, first day, probation review due)? Recommended as notifications for provia-automation-designer; none are in the assumed outline.
